description.en: ChartArena is a bilingual benchmark for chart parsing covering eight chart families (bar, line, pie, radar, box plot, combination, flowchart, mind map) across three visual scenarios (digital, printed, hand-drawn). It uses a format-agnostic evaluation protocol with structure-aware metrics.

evidence.snippet: To address these issues, we introduce ChartArena, a comprehensive bilingual benchmark covering eight chart families spanning both numeric charts and diagrammatic structures, each evaluated across three visual scenarios: digital renderings, printed photos, and hand-drawn photos.

claire_radar.motivation: Charts are a primary medium for conveying quantitative and relational information, yet systematically evaluating chart parsing models remains difficult.
claire_radar.name: ChartArena

claire_radar.paperTitle: ChartArena: Benchmarking Chart Parsing across Languages, Scenarios, and Formats

authors: Shangpin Peng and Gengluo Li and Xingyu Wan and Chengquan Zhang and Hao Feng and Binghong Wu and Huawen Shen and Weinong Wang and Ziyi Cai and Zhuotao Tian and Han Hu and Can Ma and Yu Zhou
source.title: ChartArena: Benchmarking Chart Parsing across Languages, Scenarios, and Formats

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing chart benchmarks cover limited chart types and ignore diagrammatic structures and real-world images. ChartArena provides a unified evaluation across diverse charts and scenarios, enabling assessment of model generalization and identifying capability gaps.
